# Security policy

TrueRepublic v0.4 is recovery-only and is not approved for production, mainnet,
real keys, or real funds. See the repository [security policy](../SECURITY.md)
for the maintained reporting process, automated gates, local commands, and
time-bounded exception rules.

Do not publish exploit details, credentials, private keys, mnemonics, or private
infrastructure data in a public issue. Use GitHub private vulnerability
reporting when available. The project does not currently promise a bug-bounty
payment, token reward, production support window, or response SLA.
